caption: The drawing depicts a pair of brown, rectangular paneled doors, each door divided into three vertical and four horizontal sections, creating a total of 24 square panels on the doors. The brown color is rendered using shading to suggest the wood grain and the relief of the paneling. Below the doors, there is a cross-section diagram showing the door's profile, with dimensions indicated in inches. The main doors section is labeled with widths of 23 1/2 inches and 25 inches for each door. The cross-section reveals widths of 2 1/2 inches, 7 3/4 inches, 5 inches, 7 1/4 inches, and 3 1/2 inches, representing different components of the door construction. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holt" in the lower right corner. The drawing is presented on a plain, off-white background. There is a vertical dimension line on the right side of the doors marked "6' 8"."
title: Old Paneled Doors: Main Entrance to Monastery
